actions.description: Run the scope's automatic setup (the upstream AUTOSET command)
actions.name: autoset

adjusts.description: One time base: A or B, single sweep and time/div
adjusts.name: timebase

adjusts.description: One channel: 1 or 2, invert, DC/AC and volts/div
adjusts.name: channel

facts.text: The remote interface is a serial port opened at 19200 baud with RTS/CTS, two stop bits, no parity and a one-second timeout
connect() sends a single space after opening the port
A command is written one character at a time and then a carriage return
The class has no read or query method; the only readline call is commented out
Only time bases A and B exist
A time base setting adds 32 for single sweep plus the index of the time/div value and sends TB<base>=<chr(settings)>
The time/div list has 29 entries from 50ns to 100s
A channel setting starts at 16, adds 32 for invert, 64 for AC coupling and the index of the volts/div value, then sends CH<channel>=<chr(settings)>
The volts/div list has 14 entries from 1mV to 20V
disconnect() sends rm0 and closes the port
The upstream GUI keeps separate settings for channels 1 and 2 and for time bases A and B

safe_state.description: serial remote control released with rm0 and the port closed; the scope keeps its last settings
